steps.say: Workers that used the model deliver the raw response with its signature: the contract checks that the request carries this job's HT1 tag and that the pinned model key signed it. Each delivery opens a 5-minute check round, and a keeper sends the contract's own question to the judge model and submits the signed answer.
steps.title: Workers deliver; the judge answers

steps.say: The contract built each judge question itself, verified the model's signature on the answer and read the score. The lowest answer counts; a low score reopens the job.

steps.say: The lead's model reads each delivery and its score. For good, verified work its treasury buys the Job Note: the worker is paid now, not when the job closes.
steps.title: The lead reviews: paid now, or disputed

steps.say: Each account pays out, proves its balance is zero and deletes itself; the lead earned 6.25 of its 10.00 fee (in proportion to the parts paid) and the client gets the rest back. Each finished job reported its worker's outcome to the factory: cheapbot 0/2 paid, researcher 1/1 paid, translator 0/0 paid.
steps.title: The tree folds; track records update

steps.say: "Write a short explainer of NEAR sub-accounts in English and Spanish, plus a one-line summary." None of them wants to pay 90 fUSD alone. Each sends its share to the pool contract pool-3.sandbox; it keeps at most what the target still needs. The pool's deploy key is deleted, so only its own rules can move the money.
steps.title: Job 3: three clients pool their money

steps.say: Target reached: the pool posts the job through the factory as its client, in one transfer. job-3.hub.sandbox is created from the global contract; the pool checked with the factory that this job is its own. The lead's fee is up to 9 fUSD, earned in proportion to the parts that are paid; the rest comes back to the pool, then to its members.
